name: Voltage to %
Prepare Insert Query
func:
msg.topic = "INSERT INTO atm_services (service, customer_bank, atm_id, atm_id_ii, atm_id_iii, old_atm_id, address, city, state, zone, css_branch, ip_address, password, dvr_name, css_bm_name, service_executive, engineer_name) VALUES ?";

let rows = msg.payload.map(row => [
    row.service,
    row.customer_bank,
    row.atm_id,
    row.atm_id_ii,
    row.atm_id_iii,
    row.old_atm_id,
    row.address,
    row.city,
    row.state,
    row.zone,
    row.css_branch,
    row.ip_address,
    row.password,
    row.dvr_name,
    row.css_bm_name,
    row.service_executive,
    row.engineer_name
]);

msg.payload = [rows];
return msg;
